s1.syndrome_frame: painful vulvar swelling with signs of inflammation
salient_findings: extremely painful during the past week
signs of inflammation on local examination
key_facts: left labial swelling with signs of inflammation
pain decreased and inflammation subsided after antibiotics
5 × 5 cm firm swelling of the left labia majora

raw.syndrome_frame: painful vulvar swelling with signs of inflammation
salient_findings: extremely painful during the past week
signs of inflammation on local examination
key_facts: left labial swelling with signs of inflammation
pain decreased and inflammation subsided after antibiotics
5 × 5 cm firm swelling of the left labia majora

shortlist.label: Bartholin's abscess
shortlist.why_kept: initial clinical diagnosis with signs of inflammation

shortlist.label: Epidermoid cyst
shortlist.why_kept: firm, non-cystic swelling of the labia majora

shortlist.label: Vulvar leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: firm, non-cystic swelling of the labia majora

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: firm, non-cystic swelling of the labia majora

shortlist.label: Dermoid cyst
shortlist.why_kept: firm, non-cystic swelling of the labia majora

shortlist.label: Vulvar cancer
shortlist.why_kept: persistent vulvar swelling in a young patient

shortlist.label: Hidradenoma
shortlist.why_kept: firm, non-cystic swelling of the labia majora

raw.rationale: The firm, 5 × 5 cm swelling of the left labia majora without signs of inflammation, and the patient's response to initial antibiotic treatment which may have been coincidental, suggests a solid tumor like vulvar leiomyoma

rejected.label: Bartholin's abscess
rejected.why: Initial diagnosis was reconsidered due to the swelling being firm and not cystic after inflammation subsided

rejected.label: Vulvar cancer
rejected.why: No other signs of malignancy such as everted labia minora or disrupted hymen were noted

rejected.label: Epidermoid cyst
rejected.why: The swelling was described as firm, not cystic

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipomas are typically soft and mobile, not matching the firm description

rejected.label: Dermoid cyst
rejected.why: Similar to epidermoid cyst, dermoid cysts are cystic in nature

rejected.label: Aggressive angiomyxoma
rejected.why: This condition often presents with a larger, more infiltrative mass and may not be as well-circumscribed

rejected.label: Hidradenoma
rejected.why: Hidradenomas are typically smaller and may present with overlying skin changes
